description: Election Commission - Mr. Maddakanda Panange Rathnasiri of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha Has Vacated His Office of Members of that Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
